steps: Scope and skeptical audit: address MC08, MC13, MC25, MC34 and MC35 with G4/G18 interactions. Preserve integration-v2, accepted typing/rejection exchanges and existing field-validation evidence. Declare legacy types to be observed inventory, not exhaustive permissions. For all ten packet-level unknown_reason fields, C09's nested reason and their controlling nullable leaves, supply separate observed_types and allowed_types, requiredness, conditional predicates, source locators and precedence over the old rows. Preserve the original 299-path inventory and mark unrelated predicates unfinished. Explain why explicit permitted variants are preferable to inferring a schema from observed examples.

Specify the conditional rules before examples. Cover C03 contractual_date versus party_to_contract; C05 rationale availability; C07 incremental and counterfactual-incurrence facts; and C09 required, its two routes, and nested versus packet reasons. Preserve unknown child routes when another route selects branch (a), and preserve C10 contextual reasons. Define missing, null, empty/whitespace-only and wrong-type reasons explicitly without normalizing submitted bytes or interpreting prose as fact. Distinguish inherited preservation rules from newly proposed restrictions; do not invent unknown variants for nonnullable facts. Resolve code selection between malformed packet types and invalid unknown representations, with exact field paths and shape-stage justification.

Save companion fixtures containing matched controls and single-predicate malformed variants for every scoped rule. Include valid null and valid nonempty-string reasons for the six cited null-only rows; retained unresolved and not-applicable controls; missing or malformed reasons; forbidden nulls; and C09 nested/outer conditions. Reference exact retained cases for unchanged controls. Supply complete candidate dependency/request material for representative exchanges, recomputing affected pins and identities so dependency failure cannot mask the intended shape finding. Label remaining field-local cases honestly. New rejected exchanges must specify returned stage, code, path, expected/observed values, independently decidable same-stage findings, no lookup, null unvalidated outputs and unchanged committed domains. Preserve existing V01–V16 unchanged for their separate diagnostic repair.

Create a bounded standard-library document diagnostic and fresh verification/integrity records using the same source-null-reason prefix. Derive scoped predicate outcomes from candidate values rather than comparing declared labels alone. Check observed values against permitted variants, positive reason-string admission, missing/null distinctions, malformed controls, diagnostic paths/order, exact declared mutations, source pins, dependency reachability and preserved predecessor hashes. Require each scoped predicate to have a located control and counterexample or an explicit justified disposition. Do not add a production validator or test suite. Changed predecessors, contradictory controls, wrong validation stages or unchecked scoped predicates require repair; broader missing contracts remain residuals.

Update only P16 architecture.json, result.md and progress.md to pin the amendment and record the terminal REVISE plus this task's actual completion status. Run the bounded diagnostic into a new exclusive-create verification file. Run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/check_accounting_proposal.py --phase P16 --check with stdout captured to a fresh source-null-reason structural-check filename; preserve its exit status and validate nonempty JSON. Recheck architecture pins and predecessor hashes. Investigate any failure beyond the known whole-architecture failure. Save each substantive subsection and report clock milestones as required.

Stop after the scoped type amendment, conditional rules, matched examples, fresh checks and reconciled P16 records are saved. Return PARTIAL with explicit residuals; withhold complete field-validation and P16 acceptance. The next task is V01–V16 diagnostic completion, not renewed broad discovery. If the budget ends earlier, identify the exact unfinished predicates or exchanges.
